interpretation: Prefer fewer dependencies, concepts, files, execution paths, contract authorities and LLM correction turns, but never remove an owning deterministic check merely to reduce line count.

evidence_boundary.community_reports: Practitioner experience and official capability evidence, not population consensus or local acceptance.
evidence_boundary.local_lab: Deterministic runtime, browser, Bugsink, dependency and exact-candidate evidence owns local admission decisions.
evidence_boundary.llm_claim: No reviewed source or local comparison proves a framework or browser-control transport improves LLM productivity universally.

deterministic_authority: HTTP, contract, property and integration checks at their owning boundaries
Playwright Test for critical rendered journeys
Bugsink injected-event readback for error-delivery acceptance
Exact pins, lockfile hashes, seven-day quarantine and one advisory triage queue

probabilistic_boundary.purpose: Visible purpose, hierarchy, coherence and friction judgments that deterministic assertions cannot answer economically.
conditions: repeatability measured on the exact candidate
no duplicate execution of deterministic checks merely for ceremony

retain: Bun 1.4.4 as the sole JavaScript runtime
Playwright Test as deterministic browser authority
Midscene only within the bounded probabilistic boundary
Hono for City Food Atlas and existing Hono applications
Preact and MapLibre where rich client-local interaction already justifies them
exact pins, lockfile hashes and seven-day release-age quarantine

conditional_patterns.use_when: new forms, lists and content flows are server-owned and the pattern removes client routing, fetch and state machinery
a bounded subtree has substantial local interaction state
a typed JSON consumer exists and the slice deletes handwritten transport DTOs or fetch wrappers
conditional_patterns.guard: split growing route type graphs when measured editor or compiler cost warrants it

conditional_patterns.use_when: escaped boundary defects justify the extra runtime; save minimized failures as fixed regressions
important pure logic needs proof that assertions detect plausible defects

admission.not_admitted_reason: Research interest is not replacement value. Each item needs a demonstrated gap, measured net simplification, exact-version review and separate implementation authority before admission.

overlap_rules: one owner for each HTTP scenario
one contract authority per application boundary

order: unit, regression, contract, property and integration checks
candidate hash, cleanup and provenance checks
bounded LLM review only for residual visible judgment
testing_policy.tdd: Require a meaningful failing regression for consequential bug fixes and review acceptance cases before trusting generated implementation expectations; evidence matters more than ritual.
testing_policy.http_layer: Use the existing integration runner or Playwright request support unless a language-independent Hurl boundary demonstrably removes more than it adds.
testing_policy.contracts: Add Pact-style infrastructure only for independently released consumers/providers with real compatibility risk.
testing_policy.browser: Keep a small critical Playwright suite with controlled state, stable role/test-id locators, traces and visible flake reporting.

observability_policy.reason: The current requirement is error-event capture and readback, not a second duplicate event destination or broad tracing platform.
acceptance: inject relevant browser and server/runtime errors
confirm exact event arrival and grouping
confirm readable stack and source mapping where applicable
confirm redaction and bounded sanitized agent summaries

primary_controls: reviewed transitive lockfile and artifact hashes
seven-day intake quarantine with explicit urgent-fix exception
periodic advisory refresh for released inventory
release_blockers: credible reachable severe runtime or build vulnerability
required scan missing, failed or stale
triage_not_churn: documented unreachable finding with owner and expiry
security_policy.forbidden_shortcut: Do not run forceful automatic audit fixes or broad upgrades merely to erase an advisory count.
security_policy.cadence: Scan dependency-graph changes, verify release inventory, and refresh advisories periodically; do not repeat an unchanged scan after every source edit.

llm_productivity.controlling_hypothesis: Less helps only when it reduces the total concepts and correction surface without hiding required state, lifecycle or contract behavior.
llm_productivity.comparison_rule: Hold model, prompt, task, time budget and deterministic acceptance tests constant; count retries and final correctness, not a single response size.
